Follow current location checks hourly and chooses the nearest NOAA station with hourly predictions within 150 km. Elsewhere, the tides are Open-Meteo’s modelled sea level for where you are. Choosing a station or place below keeps it fixed.
Phone location unavailable. Enable location for Pebble, then reopen settings. You can also choose a station manually.

NOAA stations give hourly harmonic predictions; heights are relative to MLLW. Open-Meteo’s model gives the sea level everywhere else, relative to mean sea level, with the highs and lows read from its curve: good for the shape of the day, not for navigation. Both refresh every six hours, and times use the station’s or place’s time zone. Neither shows observed water levels or storm surge.

The Dymaxion map projects the globe onto an icosahedron and unfolds it into flat triangles. The continents stay in one connected piece with little distortion, and no country sits at the center.

Buckminster Fuller, the designer and inventor known for the geodesic dome, published the first version in 1943. He developed the later icosahedral version, which this watch face uses, with Shoji Sadao.
